# Replay-test fixture corpus

240 stratified synthetic Plex Optimize argv captures, one per
distinct shape: `(video_codec, width, hdr_format, has_subs,
HardwareAcceleratedCodecs, HardwareAcceleratedEncoders,
TranscoderToneMapping, target_tag_id)`.

Generated by [`cmd/optimize-corpus-gen`](../../../cmd/optimize-corpus-gen)
against synthetic test clips under `/media/scaleplex-test-clips/` —
**no PII, no real user titles or paths.** Each capture file name
encodes its shape: `<codec>__<profile>__<resolution>__<depth>__<color>__<rk-prefix>-<rk-id>-<hash>.json`.

## Used by

`worker/agent/replay_test.go` and siblings (build-tag `replay`).
The build-worker CI workflow runs them as `REPLAY_NO_FFMPEG=1
go test -tags=replay -run TestReplayCorpus ./...` with
`REPLAY_CORPUS_DIR=<this directory>`. Catches rewriter regressions
per-PR without cluster access.

Tests that run against this fixture:

- `TestReplayCorpus` — every entry's argv goes through `Rewrite()`;
  rewriter-only mode (no ffmpeg spawn), so it asserts only that the
  rewriter doesn't bail unexpectedly and produces a valid result.
- `TestReplayCorpus_OrthogonalEmitParity` — compares the current
  rewriter emit against the unified `extractGraphFacts →
  composeBurn` path on abstract properties (scale w/h, has-inlineass,
  has-overlay, has-tonemap, algo). Hard-gates: `considered > 0`
  + `diffOther == 0`.
- `TestReplayCorpus_BitmapOverlayUnified` — synthetic content has no
  PGS bitmap subs, so this test cleanly skips on the fixture (no
  candidates). Real bitmap coverage runs against the live
  `~/scaleplex-corpus/` per-tag (see `docs/RELEASE_GATE.md` T2).

## Refreshing

Stale fixture risk is low — the parity test compares cur emit vs
unified emit on the SAME commit, so identical changes on both sides
preserve parity regardless of what the fixture argvs look like. Update
the fixture only if a new rewriter axis appears that the existing 240
shapes don't cover. Regenerate by running `cmd/optimize-corpus-gen`
against plex-test and re-stratifying.
